pilot_actionability_asset.reusable_precheck: A stage-localized attenuation boundary is not a repair prescription. Before scaling a diagnosis-guided repair, freeze one stage-targeted intervention plus a matched generic control while holding upstream packets fixed, and require selective movement of the targeted observable. If the treatment is delivered exactly but the treatment-minus-control margin fails prospectively, STOP that repair realization rather than searching stronger prompts on the same pilot/holdout data.
pilot_actionability_asset.does_not_imply: that the stage-resolved diagnostic object is invalid, that retrieval and policy uptake are equivalent, that the 10-state diagnostic-completeness result is false, or that every mechanistically distinct post-retrieval intervention will fail

reuse_scope.experiment_family: diagnosis-guided stage-targeted repair in persistent-memory or self-improving agents
reuse_scope.failure_mode: a correctly delivered repair at the diagnosed surface does not selectively move the targeted branch-specific observable relative to the matched generic control
reuse_scope.required_separation: diagnostic localization versus intervention realization versus repair effect

pilot_actionability_asset.reopen_condition: Use a new, mechanistically distinct intervention frozen before new outcomes; do not tune prompt strength on this pilot or reuse the sealed 23-state holdout after using pilot outcomes to design the same treatment family.

paper_version_asset.reusable_precheck: Before projecting a paper repair onto a newer canonical base, inspect whether the newer base seals a separate source tree and requires historical source immutability. A conflict-free Git cherry-pick is not semantic proof of version compatibility. Keep the historical source byte-identical and derive the next revision from the newest sealed source identity.
paper_version_asset.does_not_imply: that the engineering scientific idea is invalid or that the newer paper revision must discard the separate evidence artifact

reuse_scope.experiment_family: versioned manuscript repair under concurrent canonical updates
reuse_scope.failure_mode: an older paper-source patch applies cleanly but silently breaks an immutability contract introduced by a newer paper revision

worktree_env_asset.reusable_precheck: An isolated Git worktree does not inherit ignored credential files. Before a provider support check, bind the same canonical ignored env path already named by the frozen execution contract, verify only file availability/configuration, and never copy credentials into Git or logs. Missing worktree-local credentials are an execution-wiring failure, not provider or subscription evidence.
worktree_env_asset.does_not_imply: credential invalidity, subscription failure, provider failure, model-resolution failure, or a scientific null

reuse_scope.experiment_family: provider-backed experiments executed from isolated Git worktrees
reuse_scope.failure_mode: worktree-local .env is absent because ignored files are not copied
reuse_scope.required_preflight: explicit ignored-env binding without credential disclosure
